ESP-IDF v6.0.2 i2c_master_receive() builds READ(n-1,ACK)->READ(1,NACK)->STOP (:1334-1345) and i2c_master_transmit_receive() rejects a READ followed by STOP unless ack_val is NACK (:1459-1470); the inserted sequence matches the IDF contract
IDF maps nack_int to ACK_ERROR (:795-797) while its receive path always NACKs the last byte and succeeds, which supports the PR comment that a controller-sent NACK does not trip the ack check
readBytes drains exactly the requested bytes, so only the dummy byte is in the RX FIFO; on a failed STOP i2c_stop() resets the LP peripheral, so the discard loop cannot drop real data (:2126-2131)
